answer: The thread counter is kept in willow and lagoon shows each reset. An adversary thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 545 identities would post 921 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
